summary: envctl 0.9 changes the default lifetime for newly created environments without an explicit lifetime from 24 hours to 8 hours. Existing environments, including their expiry timestamps, are unchanged.

changes.text: New environments created without an explicit lifetime default to 8 hours rather than 24 hours.
Only newly created environments use the new default; no existing environment expiry timestamp is changed.
A newly created environment with an omitted lifetime expires after 8 hours; a simulated 12-hour overnight pipeline lost that environment before its final step as expected expiry behavior.

upgradeSteps.text: Do not rely on the prior 24-hour default for new environments. For overnight or other long pipelines, assess whether an explicit lifetime is needed.

An explicit lifetime longer than 8 hours requires organisation-policy permission. A 24-hour request is not guaranteed to be allowed; check with the organisation administrator. No universal override or automatic migration is supplied.

unknowns.text: The supplied material does not specify CLI syntax for setting an explicit lifetime or exact organisation-policy configuration.
Recovery behavior after expiry, production SLOs, and performance benchmarks are not specified.
